title: Community Intern
subtitle: Job Summary
body:
## **Job Summary**

We’re looking for a Community Building Intern who’s **ready to dive in and support our community while creating videos that actually convert**! You’ll be at the heart of our Discord community, creating short-form videos that attract affiliates sales and grow our brand.

You’ll also be creating social media content to bring in new members and directly reaching out on Discord with our proven strategies. And the best part? You’ll learn the high-demand skills of MMO, all while earning money on your own. Don't miss out on the chance to level up and make an impact. This is where your journey starts!

About the Community - DAD - An ecosystem that connects, manages and transforms affiliates into top earners through exclusive strategies, high-commission opportunities, and insider tactics.

## **Essential Roles and Responsibilities:**

- You’ll get a step-by-step guide to **clone high-converting videos, master reposting techniques, and learn editing skills** that drive results - whether it’s converting members or affiliate sales.

- **Supporting the team in managing social accounts**, including TikTok, Instagram, Discord by preparing, posting content, and seeding posts using various accounts to increase visibility and engagement.

- **Creating high-quality, convertible videos** on short-form platforms (TikTok, Shorts, Facebook Reels, etc.) using CapCut.

- **Engaging actively and preparing content for our primary community platform:** the Discord server, ensuring consistent activity, meaningful interactions, and valuable contributions that resonate with our audience.

- **Gaining access to larger Discord communities** to study and adapt successful strategies for our community.

- **Researching new trends and implementing** them to enhance our community experience.

## **Skills and Qualifications:**

- **Fluent in English communication** (Written and Spoken), equivalent to an IELTS score of 6.5

- **MUST HAVE an extra phone** to target audiences from other countries and unlock bigger opportunities.

- **Passionate **about community building and social media affiliate.

- **Experience** using Discord, Twitter, TikTok and other social network platforms.

- Proficiency in using **CapCut **is a plus.

- **Proactive learning behavior:** we encourage daily learning of skills that support your role and sharing insights with the team.

- A positive, **“can-do” attitude**.

- Alignment with our core values: **Honor Our Word, Play Like A Team Sport, Foster Innovation** (Check out more at [patigroup.com](https://patigroup.com/)). If you embody these values, show us proof!

## **Come join PATI, you can enjoy**

- **Allowance: Up to 5,000,000 VND per month**.

- Opportunity to work in a fast-growing E-commerce business.

- Opportunity to learn all the technique of MMO and earn commission.

- Participate in various team bonding activities.

We’re looking for someone who shares our passion for **wellness** and our commitment to excellence. If you believe you have the skills and mindset to thrive in this role, we’d love to hear from you.

Company Address: 152 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 25, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City

**🚀 APPLY [HERE](https://paticreativeagency.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrusjCC2CJeEWBc1wNKIX7fibc)**
